wiki.title: David B. Hawk
wiki.extract: David B. Hawk (born June 21, 1968) is an American politician who has been a member of the Tennessee House of Representatives since 2003. He represents the 5th district, encompassing portions of Greene County. He is a member of the Commerce Committee, the Conservation and Environment Committee, the Parks and Tourism Subcommittee, and the Small Business Subcommittee.
